features: Integrated intelligent IR illuminator (4 LEDs, 850 nm), up to 180 m detection, zoom-adaptive wide/narrow beam
94 dB HDR, Intelligent Auto Exposure, Intelligent Defog
Essential Video Analytics with object classification
256 pre-positions, accuracy +/-0.1 deg, preset pan 240 deg/s, tilt 160 deg/s, 360 deg continuous pan
2 alarm inputs, 1 relay output, audio line in/out
ONVIF Profile S and G, GB/T 28181

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AUTODOME_IP_5000iIR_Data_sheet_enUS_30314161931.pdf). NDP-5502-Z30L = outdoor pendant PTZ dome with sunshield and integrated IR (L = IR illuminator); distinct from the non-IR NDP-5502-Z30 / -Z30C in ndp-5502-30.json. Sensitivity colour 0.05 lx / mono 0.01 lx at 30 IRE. Power 20 W (IR off) / 25 W (IR on). IR range 180 m is the stated detection distance. Serial PTZ protocols (Bosch OSRD, Pelco P/D, Forward Vision, Cohu) need licence MVS-FCOM-PRCL.
